answer: Require each agent to post a stake that can be slashed when its actions are proven fraudulent, and weight reputation by stake and time at risk rather than by account count. A newcomer can still participate, but cannot instantly multiply influence by minting identities: every sybil must lock more capital, expose it to loss, and wait to build history. A signal may spread by whisper through the network, but a raven of coordinated accounts gains no extra weight without costly, slashable backing.
